summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new 'Fotoğraf Kontrolü' (AI-powered photo validation) feature. Backend API fully functional with all edge cases handled correctly. Feature is WARNING-ONLY as required - does not block application submission.
passed_tests: POST /api/photo/check with valid portrait image returns 200 with all required keys (checked, ok, is_photo, checks, failed, issues, advice, score)
POST /api/photo/check with non-portrait image (solid color) correctly returns is_photo=false and ok=false with issues populated
POST /api/photo/check with invalid file_id returns 404 as expected
POST /api/photo/check with PDF upload returns checked=false, reason='pdf' without error
Regression: POST /api/uploads works correctly for doc_type=passport and doc_type=photo
Regression: POST /api/passport/read works correctly (AI OCR autofill with 100% accuracy on test data)
Regression: Basic endpoints (/visa-types, /content/site, /products) all return 200 OK
Backend logs confirm /api/photo/check is being called from frontend and responding correctly
Photo validation stores check results in uploads collection with photo_check field
AI validation completes within acceptable timeframe (10-30 seconds)
Non-blocking behavior: API returns ok=true with checked=false, reason='ai_error' when AI fails (graceful degradation)

success_percentage.frontend: Not fully tested due to date picker complexity - backend integration confirmed via logs

test_scenarios.result: Returns checked=true with all required keys
test_scenarios.response_structure: ok, is_photo, checks (dict), failed (array), issues (array), advice (string), score (0-1)
test_scenarios.ai_detection: Correctly identified as non-photo (is_photo=false) due to lack of facial features

test_scenarios.result: Returns checked=false, reason='pdf' without throwing error
test_scenarios.message: Vesikalik fotografi PDF yerine JPG veya PNG olarak yukleyin.

regression_tests.passport_ocr: 100% accuracy - all 7 fields (first_name, last_name, passport_no, birth_date, passport_expiry, gender, national_id) extracted correctly
regression_tests.uploads_endpoint: Working for both passport and photo doc_types

warning_only_behavior.implementation: API returns ok=false with issues array but does NOT return error status. Frontend can display warning but user can proceed.
warning_only_behavior.ai_error_handling: When AI fails, returns ok=true, checked=false, reason='ai_error' with user-friendly message allowing continuation

frontend_integration.confirmed_via_logs: Backend logs show /api/photo/check being called from frontend with 200 OK responses
frontend_integration.note: Full UI flow test blocked by date picker component complexity. Backend integration confirmed functional via server logs.
